subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should Gateway owners accept this PR's default 5s post-clean-shutdown forced exit, strict `/healthz?strict=1` supervised preflight contract, and `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_POST_SHUTDOWN_EXIT_TIMEOUT_MS` operator override as the supported recovery behavior for zombie shutdowns?
rationale: The code is coherent and tested, but the remaining choice affects supervised Gateway availability, external/operator expectations, and a new env configuration surface, which automation should not approve as product policy.

options.title: Accept bounded recovery behavior
options.body: Merge after Gateway owner sign-off that the forced-exit watchdog and strict internal probe are the desired default recovery path for supervised zombies.

options.title: Require more upgrade proof first
options.body: Ask for final merge-head launchd/systemd restart proof or documentation before accepting the new operator contract.

options.title: Pause for an alternate lifecycle design
options.body: Hold or close this branch if maintainers prefer supervisor/doctor readiness changes over a process-level post-shutdown watchdog.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded recovery behavior
recommendation.body: Merge after Gateway owner sign-off that the forced-exit watchdog and strict internal probe are the desired default recovery path for supervised zombies.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest recent Gateway runtime/docs routing candidate among the likely owners and has multiple nearby commits in Gateway lifecycle surfaces.
